en: Woman
Did you see that man in black by the Radio Tower? He's dressed up as one of Team Rocket. What a strange costume!
That man in black really was one of Team Rocket? And I thought it was a costume!
Man in Black
So this is the Radio Tower...
What are you gawping at, kid? Beat it!
Hey, you! What are you standing about for? Get to your post!
Grunt
You don't belong here, brat. Clear off!
Relax, I've got this street covered. You should be over at the Radio Tower with the others!
Grunt
Pokémon? Tools for making money, that's all they are.
We're standing guard here. Nothing gets past us, don't you worry.
Grunt
Friends with Pokémon? Don't make me laugh.
After all these years of waiting, our dream's about to come true...
Grunt
Take over the Radio Tower? Who said anything about that? Mind your own business!
You look awfully young to be one of us. New, are you?
Grunt
You want to join up? Bad timing. We've run out of uniforms.
One of the lads went to borrow some from the photo studio in the passage under the city. What's keeping him?
A kid your age, signing up with Team Rocket? Good for you!
Grunt
Can't you see the uniform? Black as night! Aren't you scared of Team Rocket?
Nobody's going to be scared of you looking like that. Grit your teeth and scowl! Like you mean it!
Grunt
Trading with people all over the world? Not today. We've got bigger things going on.
Fancy a trade, do you? Wait until the job at the Radio Tower is done. You'll have all the time you like then.
Gym Trainer
Out of my way! We train at Whitney's Gym, and we won't let Team Rocket push our city around!
Grunt
Gym Trainers. Always getting in the way. Go back to your Gym and stay there!
Grunt
Where do you think you're going? We're in the middle of a job here!
Grunt
Wrong way! The Radio Tower's back in the city!
Grunt
I was sent here on my own, and I'm not budging. Go and bother someone else.
Grunt
Whoa, slow down! I'm the only one posted here, and nobody gets by. Don't make trouble for me, all right?
